text:
Get model answers without giving callers the provider key. Ask a question, request a structured decision, embed text, or look up models, prices and the account's credit. Send ask with a prompt, or one of the methods below.
ask <prompt...>: Get a model answer. Send prompt text for a text reply with its tokens and cost, or an OpenAI chat request for the provider response as JSON.
  prompt (json): Prompt text, or an OpenAI chat-completions object in JSON; text returns assistant text, an object returns provider JSON
decide <body...>: Get answers to typed decision questions. Send an OpenRouter Decisions request; the reply is the full provider response as JSON.
  body (string): Raw JSON request, including state, questions and the decision model; sent unchanged
models [--images] [--json] [<word>]: List the provider's models as a table: context length, USD per million input and output tokens, input kinds; the configured default is marked. With --images, image models and their price per image or megapixel, with image_model marked.
  images (bool): List image models instead
  json (bool): Return the provider's full records instead of the table
  filter (string): Keep models whose ID or name contains this word; free keeps free models
model <id>: See one model's context length, prices and input kinds, per provider endpoint; for an image model, its parameters and prices per endpoint.
  id (string): Model ID, such as openai/gpt-4.1-mini
embed <JSON text, list or request>: Turn text into vectors. Send a JSON string, a JSON list of strings, or {"input":...,"model":...}; the reply is the model and one vector per text. Other text after embed is a prompt.
  input (json): A JSON string, a JSON list of strings, or an object with input and an optional model; too many texts for one answer are refused
balance: See the account's remaining credit; role: maintainer
key: See the key's spend limit, remaining credit and rate limit, never the key itself; role: maintainer
image <JSON request>: Generate images into #ai's own bigfile record, kept 24 hours; the reply names each image with its type, size and the call's cost. Only a JSON object is a request; other text after image is a prompt.; role: maintainer
  request (json): A JSON object with prompt, and optionally model, n (1 to 4), aspect_ratio, resolution, size, output_format, quality, background, seed and input_references (https or data:image URLs)

model.help: Default chat model ID for ask/text and chat JSON requests without model; not injected into decide

embed_model.help: Default embedding model ID for embed requests without model

image_model.help: Default image model ID for image requests without model; without it and without a request model, image is refused before any provider call; models --images marks it

base_url.help: Trusted OpenAI-compatible API root; ask, embed and the lookup methods append their path, decide uses the same origin at /api/alpha/decisions

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.help: Provider API key, required. Set only in runner/ai/env on the host, never bus Secret or Configuration.
